notes.title: Looking for a party to crash? Join HotD's Supernatural Anniversary!
notes.content:
Heroes of the Dark's 1-Year Anniversary Update 7 is LIVE!

To celebrate the occasions we're bringing you exciting new in-game content like the brand-new PvP Arena and not one, but two new heroes - ‘Edrianna, the Bounty Hunter’ & ‘Sergei, the Unstoppable Woodcutter’.

The festive period is giving new and returning players alike the chance to win exclusive in-game rewards and enjoy a bustling event calendar. 

So what are you waiting for - download Heroes of the Dark and join the celebrations! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088951/1976ebcb8cd014c4f8b5be57453ec12075407be8.jpg

Update 7 Notes:

 The brand new PvP Arena will see the fiercest warriors clash in the game’s most epic cross-realm PvP challenge to date. 
 With Map Markers players will now be able to highlight strategic objectives on the world map to help navigate their individual and guild tactics.
 Two new heroes join the growing hero roster - ‘Edrianna, the Bounty Hunter’ & ‘Sergei, the Unstoppable Woodcutter’. 
 Bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: The Day the Heart Stopped Beating
notes.content:
Vampires, Werewolves, Humans... that which once divided us now unites us. The Emperor will reap what he has sown as we storm the capital, the Heart of Tenebris, and take back this land of ours! Too long have we lingered in the dark under the rule of an unbridled tyrant. Today, the Heart will stop beating and Tenebris will rise again! We'll rally our Guilds to strike at the Seats of Power, weaken the Emperor's Aura of Control and deal a killing blow! We must not let this chance slip! To arms, Heroes!

Update 5 Notes
- Venture on the ultimate quest to the Heart of Tenebris to battle its mighty ruler, Albus the Emperor, and gain control over the realm! 
- Father Arnaud, a new Human Tank, has joined the hero ranks. 
- The new Hero Filter feature gives you an easy way to sort through your hero roster. 
- March Refunds added to restore any resources lost on unsuccessful marches. 
- Forced Relocation introduced to remove enemy Mansions located on your territory. 
- Bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Heroes of the Dark - Update 4
notes.content:
𝐅𝐔𝐋𝐋 𝐂𝐇𝐀𝐍𝐆𝐄𝐋𝐎𝐆
⚫ Lots of improvements & engaging changes to our events! We’re adding Meta Events – grouping a series of different events with a special theme and even better rewards! The Calendar will show you the events 2 weeks in advance and the Cross-Realm Events will let you compete in leaderboards versus enemies from other servers!
⚫ Alfred is here to serve! The community-named humanoid is the latest Hero to join the ranks – an EPIC Human Support for your roster. (Look out for his arrival in the next few weeks!)
⚫ Block functionality added to in-game chat system allows you to stop seeing messages from players of your choice
[𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲-𝐨𝐟-𝐋𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐈𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬]
This month's update is all about making the game that little bit better for you to play in terms of quality of life, so here is where the focus really lies.
⚫ You’ll find even better crafting materials as rewards in Catacombs for Rare Heroes.
⚫ Inactive Guild Leaders will no longer be an inconvenience thanks to the new automated Guild-leadership transfer mechanic. 
⚫ Lower level player bases will no longer affect the spawn level of new enemy camps
⚫ Bug fixes
⚫ Performance improvements
